newsitem.title: NORWAY: Bad weather halts laying of Zeepipe IIB until 1997.
newsitem.headline: Bad weather halts laying of Zeepipe IIB until 1997.

text.p: Work on the Zeepipe IIB gas trunkline from the Draupner E riser platform in the North Sea to Kollsnes near Bergen on the west coast of Norway has been suspended for the year because of bad weather, Den norske stats oljeselskap (Statoil) said on Thursday.
So far 232 km of the 294-km pipeline has been laid. Pipelaying is due to resume in March, with the remaining 62 km likely to be completed within a month, Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said.
Statoil said it expected to meet the official deadline of October 1, 1997 for starting gas deliveries through Zeepipe IIB despite the delays.
